mapper.select: select i.*, p.system_prompt, p.price_prompt, p.tech_prompt, p.default_prompt, p.max_reply_length from goodfish_item i left join goodfish_item_prompt p on p.item_id = i.id where i.id = #{id} and i.del_flag = '0'
select i.*, exists(select 1 from goodfish_item_prompt p where p.item_id = i.id) as prompt_configured from goodfish_item i ${ew.customSqlSegment}

select i.goodfish_item_id, i.title, i.description, i.price, i.stock_status, i.image_url, p.system_prompt, p.price_prompt, p.tech_prompt, p.default_prompt, p.max_reply_length from goodfish_item i left join goodfish_item_prompt p on p.item_id = i.id where i.goodfish_account_id = #{goodfishAccountId} and i.goodfish_item_id = #{goodfishItemId} and i.del_flag = '0'
